jordan (support): forwarding customer report from @ace (acme) — Go SDK json decode errors on NDJSON streaming. they say it started after the infra deploy earlier today.

ace (acme): we're intermittently getting 'invalid character '\n' looking for beginning of value' when decoding the /v1/streams NDJSON. ~1/15 responses fail. using go-sdk v0.12.1. sample error log:

```
error: json: invalid character '\n' looking for beginning of value
goroutine 23 [running]:
  encoding/json.(*Decoder).Decode(0xc0000b6000, 0x12a9a40, 0xc00007c0c0, 0x0, 0x0)
  /usr/local/go/src/encoding/json/stream.go:35 +0x1b7
  main.handleStream(0xc0000a8000)
  /app/main.go:72 +0x85
```

jordan (support): thanks. @devin can you triage? suspect NDJSON framing or a client-side parsing regression.

devin (eng): on it. quick q: are they using Transfer-Encoding: chunked? any heartbeat/no-op lines emitted by your runtime? which endpoint exactly (/v1/streams or /v1/completions)?

ace (acme): endpoint is /v1/streams. headers: chunked + Content-Type: application/x-ndjson. we do emit occasional keepalive blank lines (we added a flush for long polls). repro snippet from our infra: 

```
resp, _ := http.Get("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=small")
dec := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body)
for {
  var obj map[string]interface{}
  if err := dec.Decode(&obj); err != nil {
    log.Printf("decode err: %v", err)
    break
  }
  handle(obj)
}
```

devin (eng): thanks. I repro locally with go1.20 + sdk v0.12.1 when the server injects blank lines or when chunk boundaries split multibyte UTF-8. interestingly, Go's Decoder should skip whitespace, so 'invalid character '\n'' usually means a partial token (e.g., a split inside a string) or invalid UTF-8 at boundary. can you paste raw bytes around the failing boundary (hex/base64)?

ace (acme): pasted base64 snippet of the two chunks we saw: `eyJpZCI6IjEwMSIsInRleHQiOiLwn5iI` and then later `4uIn0K` — looks like a multibyte emoji got split across chunks resulting in invalid utf8 when joined by decoder.

devin (eng): root cause hypothesis: our Go SDK streaming path used encoding/json.Decoder over the raw resp.Body without reassembling per-line frames, and if the HTTP chunk boundary splits a multi-byte UTF-8 sequence or JSON token, Decoder sees invalid bytes at the start of Decode and returns that error. additionally, server-side keepalive blank lines interact with Decoder state when partial reads occur.

ingrid (eng-ml): seen this pattern before in TS runtime. robust solution: treat NDJSON as record-delimited on '\n' and use bufio.Reader.ReadBytes('\n') to accumulate a full line before unmarshalling. Decoder is convenient but not safe across arbitrary chunk boundaries with partial UTF-8 tokens.

devin (eng): agree. plan: update go-sdk stream decoder to use a line-based reader, trim whitespace, skip empty lines, then json.Unmarshal each line. add tests for: (1) heartbeat empty lines, (2) chunk-split multibyte utf-8 inside strings, (3) interleaved partial objects. short-term workaround for customers: downgrade to sync polling mode or set server to avoid extra flushes.

jordan (support): can you open a PR and assign? also flag eng-runtime to look at upstream keepalive behavior (maybe avoid splitting multi-byte tokens on flush).

devin (eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/432 — "stream: line-based NDJSON reader, skip empty lines, add split-utf8 tests". bumped to v0.12.2-rc1. summary of changes in PR:
```
- use bufio.NewReader(resp.Body)
- for { b, err := r.ReadBytes('\n'); line := bytes.TrimSpace(b); if len(line)==0 { continue } json.Unmarshal(line, &obj) }
- tests simulate chunked responses with split utf8 and keepalives
```

ace (acme): testing v0.12.2-rc1 now against our long-running stream. first 200 responses without error. will run overnight. thanks for the quick follow. :rocket:

devin (eng): also adding a changelog note advising runtime teams to avoid emitting CRLF-only chunks; but client should be robust anyway.

ace (acme) [~12h later]: after 12 hours of smoke testing, no invalid-char errors. switching to rc1 in staging. thanks all! :white_check_mark:

jordan (support): marking ticket resolved pending the stable patch release. will coordinate the release notes and push v0.12.2 to customers.

sre-bot: deploy of go-sdk v0.12.2 to artifacts/redwood/go-sdk completed (staged).

jordan (support): closing thread — reopen if ace sees regressions.
